title: Meta’s Muse: How we launched the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
summary: Meta shares growth strategy behind launching its fastest-growing consumer product
detailed: Muse is the #1 app in the App Store and arguably the fastest-growing AI consumer product of all time.
Mona Sarantakos has led product on it since day one.
She’s VP of Product at Meta Superintelligence Labs and a 10-year Meta veteran with over 20 years of experience as a PM.
